title: Are you serious?
text: Are you serious?. These knives look ridiculous.  I mean seriously ugly.  The handles are imaged as looking like wood;  in reality they are flimsy, bronze/brass colored plastic.  They look like children’s toys!  I can’t believe anyone would give them a good review.  Laughable.
